scope: Research, architecture proposal and first local implementation. No deployment, installed-runtime validation or live-model quality experiment.

behavior: Each populated episode/claim field carries its own exact source spans.
Continuation and relation support retain resolved target identity.
Full source context can qualify or negate support; uncited passages cannot substitute for field evidence.
All fields undergo payload preflight before evaluator dispatch; batches share the existing 20-second evaluation deadline.
Rejection prevents partial commit and leaves original events available for retry.

tdd.initial_regression: AssertionError: 1 != 2; one aggregate record was sent instead of two field checks.
tdd.seams: Public processing API plus real temporary Store/ProjectMemory; external generator and evaluator are injected.

earlier_full_run.followup: All 14 hook-runner tests passed independently in 17.781 seconds; full suite then passed without parallel packaging/browser checks. No hook code or threshold changed.

validation.python_syntax: py_compile passed for changed product modules and new test file; repository config has no required global typechecker.

architecture.maintenance: snapshot, full finalize, seal, check completed; hashes_match
architecture.semantic_review: Descriptions and changed source line references reviewed centrally and by two reviewers. Hash equality alone is not semantic proof.
architecture.earlier_browser_check: Sandbox Chrome DevTools pipe failed. Full finalization passed with browser access; both receipts retained.

reviews.spec: No actionable findings for agreed first slice. Independent reviewer reran all 12 public tests successfully.

cost_and_limits.derivation: 8 episodes * (5 narrative fields + 1 continuation) + 8 claims * 3 fields + 8 relations
cost_and_limits.behavior_on_oversize: Reject before any evaluator call; original events remain available. Full source context increases payloads and may reject inputs that previously fitted.
cost_and_limits.behavior_on_deadline: Do not dispatch further batches or commit partial derived memory.
cost_and_limits.request_bound_reason: Each item has title/body assertions. One refinement pass can split their two question pairs into two requests. 80 aggregate + 80 * 2 refinement requests is a conservative bound before the shared deadline.

limitations: Injected evaluators verify contract and processing behavior, not semantic model accuracy.
No measured improvement in production answer quality or cost.
The optional gate is not enabled globally by this change.
No installed service or MCP connection was changed or validated.
Cross-episode reconciliation, salient-signal outcome tracking and the 120-question comparative experiment remain proposals.
